observations: Front-load washing machine, white body, LG logo on top-left front panel.
Text on panel reads 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' with a smaller model code beneath it that is too blurred to fully confirm (appears to start with F1068Q...).
Control dial and buttons (Spin, Temp, Rinse+Spin, etc.) visible, consistent with LG front-loader layout.
Green sticker reads 'Less Noise, Less Vibration, More Durability' with LG Inverter DD Motor logo.
'10 Year Warranty' DD Motor badge visible on right side of panel.
Visible rust staining around the door rim, lower-left and lower-right corners of the front panel, and near the base.
Floor and surrounding area look like an outdoor or semi-covered storage space, not a clean indoor showroom.
No visible power cord, plug, or indication the unit is connected to power.
No photo of the drum running, water filling, or the back panel (where rust/leak damage often starts).

identity.model: DirectDrive 7kg (exact suffix code unclear, appears to start with F1068Q...)

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows LG logo and 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' text on the control panel

claims.claim: Implied that the machine is functional and for sale as a working unit
claims.evidence: No photo or video shows the machine powered on, filling, spinning, or draining

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or complete a wash cycle (motor, PCB, or inverter fault)
risks.proof: Short video of the machine plugged in, powering on, and running a spin cycle with the door closed

risks.risk: Visible rust around door seal and base may indicate water leakage or internal corrosion over time
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted areas, the rear panel, and the drum interior/seal
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural damage present, lowering condition grade

risks.risk: Door seal (rubber gasket) condition unknown, tears or mold could cause leaks
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rubber door gasket, inside and out
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming gasket may need replacement

risks.risk: Unknown age and usage history, no original packaging or proof of purchase shown
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/serial number sticker (usually on the back or side) and any purchase receipt

risks.risk: Exact model suffix unreadable, which affects feature set (e.g., steam, spin speed) and resale value
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the full model code on the panel
risks.if_unproven: priced at base 7kg DirectDrive tier without premium features

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and completing a short spin cycle
Close-up photo of the full model/serial plate (usually rear or side of unit)
Close-up photos of the rusted areas on the front panel and base
Photo of the rear panel and hoses for leak/corrosion signs
Close-up of the door rubber gasket, inside and out
response.reason: Brand, type, and claimed capacity are visible and consistent with an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-loader, but there is no proof the unit powers on or completes a cycle, and visible rust raises condition concerns, so it must be priced at worst case as a non-working, visibly rusted used unit until functional and condition proof is provided.
